description: Work with the Measurement Log panel (Window > Measurement Log): export all or the selected measurements to a tab-delimited text file, delete them, select or deselect all rows, toggle Auto Display Panel, or show or hide the panel

dataPoints.description: Data points (Image > Analysis > Select Data Points), by their names in the Measurement Log, e.g. "Area", "Perimeter", "Count", "Length", "Angle". Default: the current choice

filePath.description: export: absolute path of a .txt or .csv file

range.description: export and delete: all rows or the selected ones. Default all

name: manage_measurement_log
title: Manage Measurement Log
